avoid_supplements.name: Iron supplements
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Lansoprazole increases gastric pH, reducing iron absorption by up to 60%
avoid_supplements.action: Separate administration by at least 2 hours; consider IV iron if oral absorption critical

avoid_supplements.name: Calcium supplements
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Reduced gastric acidity impairs calcium carbonate absorption; citrate formulations less affected
avoid_supplements.action: Use calcium citrate formulation; separate dosing by 2+ hours or monitor for deficiency

avoid_supplements.name: Vitamin B12 supplements
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Long-term PPI use reduces intrinsic factor and B12 absorption from food sources
avoid_supplements.action: Monitor B12 levels annually; consider cyanocobalamin supplementation for chronic users

caution_supplements.name: Magnesium supplements
caution_supplements.mechanism: PPIs may increase magnesium depletion risk with chronic concurrent use
caution_supplements.action: Monitor serum magnesium levels; supplement if deficiency develops

caution_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
caution_supplements.mechanism: May induce CYP3A4, potentially reducing lansoprazole levels
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for reduced PPI efficacy; consider alternative herbal products

avoid_foods.name: High-fat meals
avoid_foods.mechanism: Delays lansoprazole absorption and reduces peak plasma concentration
avoid_foods.action: Administer 30-60 minutes before meals on empty stomach for optimal bioavailability

caution_foods.name: Grapefruit juice
caution_foods.mechanism: Potential CYP3A4 inhibition may increase lansoprazole exposure
caution_foods.action: Limit consumption; monitor for increased side effects

caution_foods.name: Caffeine-containing foods/beverages
caution_foods.mechanism: May increase gastric irritation and reduce therapeutic benefit in some patients
caution_foods.action: Counsel patients to moderate intake; not absolutely contraindicated

monitoring_notes: Monitor for vitamin B12, magnesium, and calcium deficiencies with chronic lansoprazole use (>1 year). Assess for hypomagnesemia-induced hypokalemia and consider baseline/annual micronutrient screening in at-risk populations.
